```{r}
ant_ice <- CDR() |>
  cdo_monmean() |>
  cdo_setday(1) |>
  cdo_settime("00:00:00") |>
  cdo_execute() |>
  ReadNetCDF("aice") |>
  setnames(c("xgrid", "ygrid"), c("x", "y")) |>
  _[, daice := c(diff(aice), NA), by = .(x, y)]

temp_era_mon <- ERA5_t2m() |>
  cdo_monmean() |>
  cdo_setday(1) |>
  cdo_settime("00:00:00") |>
  cdo_execute() |>
  ReadNetCDF("t2m") |>
  setnames(c("xgrid", "ygrid"), c("x", "y"))

daice <- ant_ice |>
  _[year(time) > 1983] |>
  _[temp_era_mon[year(time) >= 1983], on = .NATURAL] |>
  _[year(time) < 2024] |>
  _[, t2m := t2m - 273.15] |>
  identity()
```

```{r}
cut_mid <- \(x, width, center) {
  breaks <- AnchorBreaks(center + width / 2, binwidth = width)(range(x))

  santoku::chop(x, breaks, labels = santoku::lbl_midpoints()) |>
    as.character() |>
    as.numeric()
}
```

```{r}

grid_monthly <- daice |>
  _[year(time) > 1983] |>
  _[!is.na(daice)] |>
  _[,
    .(daice = mean(daice), n = sum(!is.na(daice))),
    by = .(
      t2m = cut_mid(t2m, 0.5, 0),
      aice = cut_mid(aice, 0.05, 0)
    )
  ]
```

grid_monthly |>

```{r}
get_model <- function(x) {
  dir_part(x, 7)
}

get_experiment <- function(x) {
  dir_part(x, 6)
}

cmip_augment <- function(files) {
  data.table(
    file = files,
    model = get_model(files),
    experiment = get_experiment(files),
    variable = dir_part(files, 3),
    member = dir_part(files, 5)
  )
}


cmip_get <- function(variable, experiment, member = "r1i1p1f1", model = "*") {
  CJ(variable = variable, experiment = experiment) |>
    glue::glue_data(
      "/g/data/oi10/replicas/CMIP6/*/*/{model}/{experiment}/{member}/*mon/{variable}/gn/*/*"
    ) |>
    Sys.glob() |>
    cmip_augment() |>
    _[]
}

```

```{r}
cmip_selantmerge <- function(files) {
  lapply(files, \(x) {
    x |>
      cdo_remapnn("r360x180") |>
      cdo_sellonlatbox(0, 360, -90, -50)
  }) |>
    cdo_mergetime() |>
    cdo_execute(options = "-L -O")
}
```

```{r}
cmip_complete <- function(data) {
  incomplete <- data |>
    tidyr::complete(model, experiment, member, variable) |>
    as.data.table() |>
    _[is.na(file)] |>
    _[, unique(model)]

  data[!(model %in% incomplete)]
}
```

```{r}
options(rcdo_silent = FALSE)
old <- cdo_cache_set(here::here("data/cache/cmip6"))
cmip_files <- cmip_get(
  variable = c("tas", "siconc"),
  experiment = c("historical", "ssp585")
) |>
  cmip_complete() |>
  _[,
    .(file = list(future(cmip_selantmerge(file)))),
    by = .(experiment, model, variable)
  ] |>
  _[, file := unlist(value(file))] |>
  _[]
cdo_cache_set(old)
options(rcdo_silent = FALSE)
```



```{r}

grid_ice <- (function(aice, tas, time = c(NA, NA)) {
  subset <- list(time = time)

  aice <- aice |>
    cdo_divc(100) |>
    cdo_execute() |>
    ReadNetCDF(c(aice = "siconc"), subset = subset) |>
    na.omit() |>
    _[, daice := c(diff(aice), NA), by = .(lon, lat)]

  tas <- ReadNetCDF(tas, c(t2m = "tas"), subset = subset) |>
    _[, t2m := t2m - 273.15]

  tas[aice, on = .NATURAL] |>
    _[,
      .(daice = mean(daice, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(daice))),
      by = .(t2m = cut_mid(t2m, 0.5, 0), aice = cut_mid(aice, 0.05, 0))
    ]
}) |>
  memoise::memoise(cache = cachem::cache_disk(here::here("data/cache/memoise")))

```


```{r}
cmip_grid <- cmip_files |>
  _[model != "CanESM5"] |>
  dcast(experiment + model ~ variable, value.var = "file") |>
  na.omit() |>
  _[,
    grid_ice(siconc, tas, time = c("1983-01-01", NA)),
    by = .(experiment, model)
  ]

cmip_grid2 <- cmip_files |>
  _[model != "CanESM5"] |>
  dcast(experiment + model ~ variable, value.var = "file") |>
  na.omit() |>
  _[experiment == "historical"] |>
  _[, experiment := "historical_old"] |>
  _[,
    grid_ice(siconc, tas, time = c(NA, "1983-01-01")),
    by = .(experiment, model)
  ]

cmip_grid <- rbind(cmip_grid, cmip_grid2)
```

```{r}
ice_rmse <- merge(
  grid_monthly,
  cmip_grid,
  by = c("t2m", "aice"),
  suffixes = c("_cmip6", "_obs")
) |>
  _[t2m > -15] |>
  #   _[,
  #   .(rmse = cor(daice_cmip6, daice_obs, use = "complete.obs")),
  #   by = .(model, experiment)
  # ] |>

  _[,
    .(rmse = sqrt(mean((daice_cmip6 - daice_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE))),
    by = .(model, experiment)
  ] |>
  _[, order := rmse[experiment == "historical"], by = model] |>
  _[, model := reorder(model, -order)]

ice_rmse |>
  ggplot(aes(model, rmse)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = experiment), position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "RMSE")

```

```{r}
cdo_area <- function(x) {
  x |>
    cdo_divc(100) |>
    cdo_fldint() |>
    cdo_execute()
}

ice_area <- cmip_files |>
  _[variable == "siconc"] |>
  _[,
    ReadNetCDF(
      cdo_area(file),
      c(aice = "siconc"),
      subset = list(time = c("1983-01-01", NA))
    ),
    by = .(experiment, model)
  ]


ice_area_obs <- ant_ice |>
  _[, .(aice = sum(aice, na.rm = TRUE) * 25000 * 25000), by = .(time)] |>
  _[, .(aice = mean(aice, na.rm = TRUE)), by = year(time)]
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
ice_area |>
  _[model != "CanESM5"] |>
  _[experiment == "historical"] |>
  _[year(time) > 1980] |>
  _[, .(aice = mean(aice)), by = .(model, experiment, year(time))] |>
  ice_rmse[i = _, on = .NATURAL] |>
  _[,
    rmse := cut(
      rmse,
      breaks = quantile(rmse, probs = c(0, 1 / 3, 2 / 3, 1)),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = c("low error", "mid error", "high error")
    )
  ] |>
  ggplot(aes(year, aice)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = model)) +
  geom_line(data = ice_area_obs[year < 2015], color = muted("violet")) +
  facet_wrap(~rmse, ncol = 1) +
  labs(y = "Annual mean area", x = NULL) +
  interactivity()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
obs_trend <- ice_area_obs[year < 2015] |>
  _[, FitLm(aice, year)] |>
  _[term == "year"]

ice_area |>
  _[model != "CanESM5"] |>
  _[experiment == "historical"] |>
  _[, .(aice = mean(aice)), by = .(model, experiment, year(time))] |>
  _[, FitLm(aice, year), by = .(model, experiment)] |>
  _[term == "year"] |>
  ice_rmse[i = _, on = .NATURAL] |>
  ggplot(aes(rmse, estimate)) +
  geom_point(aes(label = model)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = obs_trend$estimate,
    colour = muted("violet")
  ) +
  labs(y = "Linear trend", x = "RMSE") +
  interactivity()

```
